title: Reflexivity of shifted agreement
statement: Let $r$ be a natural number and $c$ a configuration. The configurations $c$ and $c$ agree with shift $0$ and radius $r$: their states, input-head positions, and outputs coincide; their work-tape head positions differ by $0$ on every tape; and for every tape $i$ and cell $z$ with the head position on tape $i$ minus $r$ at most $z$, the tape contents at $z$ coincide.
